intro.title: What is it and why does it exist?
intro.paragraph1: Prod-UIBO is a web-based productivity timer designed to help users manage their time and stay focused during work or study sessions. Unlike other timers, its core is personalization, letting users fully adapt the visual and audio environment to create an ideal space for concentration.
intro.paragraph2: Most productivity tools are functional but visually dull, or beautiful but lacking flexibility. Prod-UIBO was born from the need for a tool that doesn't force you to choose. The goal was to build a timer that isn't just a stopwatch, but a truly customizable workspace that users actually enjoy using, combining modern design with detailed configuration.
intro.highlightPrefix: Prod-UIBO isn't just a stopwatch — it's a
intro.highlightSuffix: that adapts to you, not the other way around.

pomodoro.title: The Pomodoro Technique
pomodoro.intro: Prod-UIBO implements the famous Pomodoro technique, a proven method to maximize productivity and keep your mind focused.

steps.title: Choose a task
steps.description: Pick a specific activity that requires your full attention

steps.title: 25 minutes of focus
steps.description: Set the timer and work without interruptions until it rings

steps.title: 5-minute break
steps.description: Take a short break to recharge your mental energy

steps.title: Repeat the cycle
steps.description: After 4 pomodoros, take a long break of 15-30 minutes

cards.title: Immersive Personalization
cards.description: Choose between static themes and animated video backgrounds. Each theme adjusts the interface and text colors to ensure readability and create a unique atmosphere.

cards.title: Ambient Sounds
cards.description: Includes a background sound player (rain, music, etc.) with volume control to block out distractions and improve concentration.

cards.title: Total Flexibility
cards.description: From preset timers to manual input and a built-in task list. Includes a Mini Mode for a compact, distraction-free view.

items: Software: Version 1.0 functional and deployed. The web app is fully operational.

Implemented Features: Complete timer system (start, pause, reset, stop), task management, and a robust settings panel with general options, a theme system (static and animated) and background sound control with volume.
Coming Soon: Cloud sync to save your tasks and settings, and a mobile app to access Prod-UIBO from anywhere.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At PROD-UIBO we respect your privacy. This policy describes what data we collect, how we use it, and your rights over it.

sections.heading: Data we collect
sections.content: We collect only the data needed for the app to function: your email address for authentication, your preference settings (theme, sound, language), and Pomodoro session data (duration, associated tasks, timestamps). We do not collect location data, contacts, or financial information.

sections.heading: How we use your data
sections.content: Your data is used exclusively to: authenticate your account, sync your sessions and settings across devices, and generate your productivity statistics. We do not sell, share, or transfer your data to third parties.

sections.heading: Storage and security
sections.content: Data is stored in Supabase (PostgreSQL) with Row Level Security (RLS) policies enabled, meaning only you can access your own data. Passwords are managed through Supabase Auth and are never stored in plain text.

sections.heading: Offline data
sections.content: When you use the app without an internet connection, your data is temporarily stored in IndexedDB in your browser. This data syncs automatically with the server when your connection is restored.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.content: You can export all your data at any time from the settings section (JSON or CSV format). If you wish to delete your account and all associated data, you can contact us and we will process the request.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By using PROD-UIBO you accept the following terms. If you disagree, please do not use the application.

sections.heading: Service description
sections.content: PROD-UIBO is a free web-based productivity application based on the Pomodoro technique. It is provided 'as is', with no guarantees of continuous availability or guaranteed technical support.

sections.heading: Acceptable use
sections.content: You agree to use the application solely for personal productivity purposes. The following are not permitted: attempting to access other users' data, reverse-engineering the source code, using the application for illegal activities, or attempting to overload or interfere with the servers.

sections.heading: User accounts
sections.content: You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account and password. PROD-UIBO is not responsible for unauthorized access resulting from the disclosure of your credentials.

sections.content: PROD-UIBO and all its content (code, design, media) are owned by Alan Rodrigo Ramírez Luna, licensed under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. Commercial use and derivative works are not permitted without authorization.

sections.heading: Limitation of liability
sections.content: PROD-UIBO is not responsible for loss of session data, service interruptions, or any direct or indirect damages arising from the use of the application.

sections.heading: Modifications
sections.content: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Changes will be reflected on this page with the corresponding update date.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: PROD-UIBO uses local storage technologies to function properly. Below we explain which ones and why.

sections.heading: What do we use?
sections.content: We do not use tracking cookies or third-party cookies. The application uses: localStorage for language preferences and interface state, IndexedDB for offline caching of sessions and settings, and a Supabase Auth session cookie to keep you signed in.

sections.heading: Authentication cookie
sections.content: Supabase Auth sets a secure cookie (HttpOnly, SameSite) containing your session token. This cookie is strictly necessary for sign-in and is removed when you sign out.

sections.heading: No tracking
sections.content: We do not use Google Analytics, Facebook Pixel, or any other tracking or advertising service. We do not collect browsing behavior data outside of the application.

sections.heading: Management
sections.content: You can delete all local data by clearing your browser's storage for this site. Note that this will sign you out and remove the offline cache until the next sync.
